title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the flow save's retired-spelling replay verdict out of protocol.ts into protocol-flow-save-replay.ts (#25467 cut 18)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 18 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–17 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014, #26104, #26168 and #26264. The claim is `6425711631`. The scope is the cut 18 proposal of the cut 17 report (`6423385238`), as the server seat approved it in its dispatch order. The member passed the AST screen and moved unedited.

One `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` member moves unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-flow-save-replay.ts` (#23050 shape B):

- `flowSaveReplaysRetired`: the flow save's retired-spelling replay verdict (#23903 ruling B′). It answers whether a flow save may keep the full conversion chain, because every retired spelling its body carries is one that a stored row already carries.

`protocol.ts` loses 46 net lines (29,290 to 29,244). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It was restarted from `main` `0a1061a61c` after cut 17 merged. The branch names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds two commits:

- the move commit `e6ddd60ba6`;
- the merge of `main` `8faba89e69` (`5a7ad6a7b2`).

That merge touches no file of `packages/metadata-protocol/`: the package's `src/` tree is `23f9f0cc` at both ends. It does change the root `tsconfig.json` and two other packages' `package.json`, so the workspace was rebuilt in full and the package re-measured after it.

## Serial with the file's in-flight PRs

Measured just before this PR was opened: of the 23 open PRs, three touch `packages/metadata-protocol/src/`. Each was checked with `git merge-tree` against this branch's head (`5a7ad6a7b2`).

**#26138** edits seven `protocol.*.test.ts` files, none of which names the moved member, `FLOW_FALLBACK_VERDICT_NOT_REPLAYED` or the new module. Its merge-tree reports one conflict, in `packages/spec/src/ui/visibility-alias-keys-retirement.test.ts`, which #26138 has with `main` itself (a merge-tree against `origin/main` alone reports it too).

**#26305** (head `1267e3cb2b`) adds 26 lines to `protocol.ts`, at `:27` (imports), `:7145` and `:7540`. The merge-tree is **clean** (exit 0).

**#26244** (draft, head `c33b95d89f`) edits `protocol.ts` (+5 / −2). Its hunks are the `@objectstack/spec/contracts` import lines at `:166–167` and a host literal at `:23178`. The merge-tree **conflicts in `protocol.ts`**, at the import block only. #26244 rewrites lines 166–167. This cut rewrites the adjacent line 168, dropping `ALL_CONVERSIONS` from the `@objectstack/spec` import. Git refuses adjacent edits as one conflict. The resolution is the union of both sides:

```ts
import type { IFieldFileService, IPubSub } from '@objectstack/spec/contracts';
import { FIELD_FILE_SERVICE, RLS_MEMBERSHIP_RESOLVER_SERVICE } from '@objectstack/spec/contracts';
import { applyConversionsToFlow, applyConversionsToStoredItem, type ConversionNotice, type ConversionTodoNotice } from '@objectstack/spec';
```

The `:23178` hunk merges clean. The same merge-tree also conflicts in `packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts`. That conflict is between #26244 and `main` itself: a merge-tree of #26244 with `origin/main` alone shows the same conflict. It is not this cut's.

Whichever PR lands second takes the three-line resolution above. The `ALL_CONVERSIONS` drop is owed, not optional: the moved body was its last reader in `protocol.ts`, so keeping it would leave an unused import.

## The order's screen (private statics, `new Error(`)

The member passed both checks:

- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`.
- **No error constructed.** The body has no `new Error(` and no other error constructor, so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed. It has no `try`, no `catch` and no log line.

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flowSaveReplaysRetired` | `:6599` | private async | 55 | 642 |

The proposal said 55 body lines.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–17 apply it)

- **The class keeps the member** with its name, docblock, signature and position. Its body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 18]`.
- **Typing.** `FlowSaveReplayHost` types its one member as the class member itself, `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['getOverlayRepo']`. The function types its `this` as `Pick<FlowSaveReplayHost, 'getOverlayRepo'>`. The stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType<typeof flowSaveReplaysRetired>`. No member changes visibility.
- **Members read**, measured by an AST walk over property and element accesses on `this`, with `as` casts, parentheses and `!` stripped, and bare `this` checked too. The body reads `getOverlayRepo` only. It is handed over as a closure that calls the method on the protocol at call time. A test that sets `protocol.getOverlayRepo = ...` on the instance (`protocol.driver-text-disclosure.test.ts` does) still reaches the body.
- **Every other caller still calls the class method.**

## Module-level declarations, by reader

Measured by an AST walk over the body's identifiers, against `protocol.ts`'s top-level declarations and import bindings. Property names are excluded.

| Name | Where `protocol.ts` has it | Other readers in `protocol.ts` | What this cut does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FLOW_FALLBACK_VERDICT_NOT_REPLAYED` | `const` at `:3358` | 1 (the save door's flow fallback in `saveMetaItem`, base `:20930`) | gains `export` in place; the new module imports it at runtime |
| `ALL_CONVERSIONS` | the `@objectstack/spec` import, `:168` | **0**, so the moved body was its last reader | leaves the import, and the new module imports it from `@objectstack/spec` |
| `applyConversionsToFlow`, `ConversionNotice` | the same `@objectstack/spec` import | yes | stay; the new module imports them from there too |
| `itemDiscriminator` | the `@objectstack/metadata-core` import | yes | stays; imported from there too |
| `MetadataWriteFace` | exported type alias | yes | already exported; imported as a type |

`FLOW_FALLBACK_VERDICT_NOT_REPLAYED` is not re-exported from `index.ts`, so the package's export table and `.d.ts` do not change (see below). The new module's runtime import of it from `./protocol.js` follows the cycle that earlier modules already use (`protocol-publish-batch.ts`, `protocol-stored-overlay-reads.ts`). It reads the constant only at call time.

The one new statement in `protocol.ts` is the import of the new module.

## The durability `--list`

`check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output. Its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped**: 159 lines, and no entry changes file. The body has no `catch` and makes no engine call. Its two reads are `repo.headAt(...)` on the overlay repository.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`, sorted-union identity, measured first.

Base `0a1061a61c` and head `e6ddd60ba6` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (119/119). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base and restored from `HEAD` under a trap. Afterwards `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` was clean, and both touched blobs equalled `HEAD`'s.

The readings were taken on the pre-merge tree and again after merging `main` (head `5a7ad6a7b2`, closure rebuilt by a full `pnpm build`, 119/119). They hold for both:

- **Raw sha256**: `08914e65f936a2b031c3f3f215481a97f53d132eefd869e4f42d928947ebe173` at base and at head, on both `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`, 775,874 bytes each. **Raw identity holds**, so sorted-union identity holds too. The member stays a `private NAME;` line, and the newly exported `FLOW_FALLBACK_VERDICT_NOT_REPLAYED` does not appear.
- **Normalised sha256**: `46ccd7e5c4db673652513d1801ec9c9f06bf34a0a7fb6ba97fb2531ef0cc544b` at both ends (80 string-literal union runs sorted, using the cut 12 normaliser).
- **The two builds differ where they should.** `index.js` hashes `8732ec7d7e0d5cd5…` at base and `74a6c78db7e9bcc6…` at head. The `.call(host` site of `flowSaveReplaysRetired` occurs 0 times in the base bundles and once in the head bundles, ESM and CJS alike. `function flowSaveReplaysRetired(` appears 0 times at base and once at head.
- **Positive control** on the head tree. `private` was dropped from `flowSaveReplaysRetired` on disk (restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `bd3b47c8b435f536…` (normalised `164c324a9516551e…`) and print `flowSaveReplaysRetired(request: { name: string; item?: unknown; packageId?: string | null; …`. So the bar can see a change on this member.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head. The sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all four. Neither the moved function, `FlowSaveReplayHost` nor `FLOW_FALLBACK_VERDICT_NOT_REPLAYED` appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

**Body, by AST token.** The compare reads the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, skipping JSDoc, over the parameters (less the added `this`), the return type and the body. It runs base `protocol.ts` at `0a1061a61c` against the head module:

```
flowSaveReplaysRetired: base tokens 642, head tokens 642, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=642 differ=0 members=1
CLASS members base=300 head=300 order-same=true byte-identical=299 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=1 other=[]
TOP base=246 head=247 byte-identical=244
```

**Negative control.** One token was changed in an in-memory copy of the head module (`mode === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'active'` to `mode !== 'draft' ? …`, one occurrence):

```
MUTATED packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-flow-save-replay.ts "mode === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'active'" -> "mode !== 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'active'"
flowSaveReplaysRetired: base tokens 642, head tokens 642, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
TOTAL tokens=642 differ=1 members=1
```

- **Class side.** There are 300 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 299 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. The stub sits at its base position and keeps its docblock and signature byte-identical (everything before the body's opening brace). The base signature spans lines (`(request: {` … `}, mode: …): Promise<boolean> {`). The module splits the two parameters onto their own lines. The token compare shows that this changes whitespace only.
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** 244 of the 246 base statements are byte-identical, leading comments included. The other two are the `@objectstack/spec` import, which loses `ALL_CONVERSIONS`, and `FLOW_FALLBACK_VERDICT_NOT_REPLAYED`, which gains `export`. Head adds one statement, the import of the new module.
- **Size.** +123 / −54 over 2 files, 177 changed lines. `protocol-flow-save-replay.ts` has 115 lines.

## Readers of the moved lines

Every test and script that reads `protocol.ts` by path (70 files) was grepped for the member name and for the identifiers its body uses: `ALL_CONVERSIONS`, `applyConversionsToFlow`, `FLOW_FALLBACK_VERDICT_NOT_REPLAYED`, `getOverlayRepo`, `headAt`, `excludeConversionIds`, `includeRetired`, `retiredFromLoadPath`, and the local names. So were all test files in `packages/` and `ui/`, and `docs/qa/`.

- **`protocol.view-expansion-reconcile-call-sites.test.ts`** reads `protocol.ts` by path. It holds a census of stored-row WRITES (`repo.put/delete/promoteDraft/restoreVersion(`, raw `sys_metadata` engine writes). It also pins that a repository is bound only as `const repo = this.getOverlayRepo();`. The moved body binds `repo` that way and calls only `repo.headAt(`, a read. So the census loses no write, and no pin edit is owed. Six earlier seam modules already bind `this.getOverlayRepo()` outside `protocol.ts` on the same footing (`protocol-drafts.ts`, `protocol-publish-batch.ts`, `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` and others). The pin passes at both ends, in the package suite.
- **No other by-path reader reads a moved body.** `protocol.driver-text-disclosure.test.ts` and `protocol.object-registry-write-through-spelling.test.ts` match on `getOverlayRepo`, but as an instance override or call, not the moved text.
- **Behaviour through the class method, no edit owed.** `packages/rest/src/meta-flow-save-retired-spelling.test.ts` names `flowSaveReplaysRetired` in its header and drives it through the save door. It was run at head after the full build: 1 file, 10 tests passed.
- No hit in `docs/qa/`.
- **ADR anchors.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 with identical output at both ends. The body cites `[#23903, ruling B′]`, an issue citation that moves with it, and no ADR.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`). It exits 0 at both ends. The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (13976 → 13930, 14001 → 13955). `productionFiles` is 3,739 at base and 3,741 at head. Of the +2, one is the new file and one is the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` that the spec build writes in the head tree.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity` and `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `0a1061a61c`.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` finds 0 of 2 paths in the register, so the change is NOT governed. At 177 changed lines it is under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 before and after the merge. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 with no output. It covers the whole touched package, which has no `lint` script; these are the root `lint` script's flags.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status. Each run used vitest `--maxWorkers=2` with the JSON reporter under the shared verify lock, and both legs gave `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The runs are on the pre-merge tree; the merge changed no file of the package.
  - Base `0a1061a61c`: 21,558 tests (21,539 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 269 files.
  - Head `e6ddd60ba6`: 21,558 tests (21,539 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 269 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `0a1061a61c` (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` on the merged tree: OK, with 1 anchored file in the change set, 29 anchors judged and 0 lost.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 51 gates on 2 changed paths from the merged tree `5a7ad6a7b2`; all 51 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (119/119). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 51 derived, 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. The derivation flags the tree as behind `main`, but only for `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs` and `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/i18n.json`; neither feeds one of these 51 families. Re-deriving against the newer `main` gives the same 51-line list, so `main` was not merged again.

## Carry-forward

Unchanged from cut 17. These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- The bodies kept by a reader: `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `packagelessAddress`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType`, `metaTypeNamespaceExists`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`, the 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` and `ensureObjectStorage`.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable`.
